product_metadata.title: iwoly V600 Vacuum Cleaner Corded Bagless Stick and Handheld Vacuum for Hard Floor (Blue)
features: ►V600 stick vacuum with powerful vacuum and it is equipped with the floor head for marble, tile and hardwood floor. You can use it to pick up all kinds of crumbs, hair, dust and even cat litter. Your floor will be much cleaner than ever. (NOTE: Due to powerful suction, it is easy to fit tightly with sealed carpets and it is hard to move on shaggy plush carpet and rugs.)

►Lightweight vacuum cleaner: The body of this 2-in-1 stick and handheld vacuum is only 3.3 lbs. Carry it upstairs or between rooms with ease. Effortlessly reaching hard-to-clean spots like ceilings and light fixtures.
►Reach high & low: Use the adjustable extension tube to add an extra 17-28 inches. Clean under furniture or even reach ceiling fans and vents.And clean in one pass with a 16.4 ft long power cord.

►User-friendly: Comes with an easy-to-clean dustbin, advanced cyclone HEPA filtration system, effectively spins dust away from motor and keeps the powerful suction, good ideal for home with pets and children.
►What’s included: machine, floor head, upholstery tool, dusting brush, crevice tool, telescopic tube, instruction manual .
description: iwoly V600 stick vacuum cleaner provides a powerful vacuum suction, sucking in dirt with ease.16.4ft long power cord allows cleaning of an entire bedroom, living room or kitchen.It only weighs 4.8 pounds and is easy to maneuvers around or under furniture or even reach ceiling fans and vents thanks to its flexible swivel steering and the adjustable extension tube.
The stick vacuum is simple to switch to a handheld vacuum to clean up the keyboard and sofa with brush nozzle,or clean up any tight spaces with crevice nozzle.
Cleans Up, Down and All Around

The corded vacuum cleaner offers the power you need to make it easier than ever to clean up, down and all-around.And the handheld vacuum cleaner weighs only 3.3 lbs,it is light enough to move or carry up the stairs with ease.

HEPA filtration system can lock in small particles and keep the air clean. A great bagless vacuum cleaner for the hardwood floor, upstairs, corners and ceilings. Bin volume is 0.14 gallons.One button release dirt cup to empty the container filled with dust without getting your hands dirty.
The corded vacuum can be hung on the wall after cleaning is over. Makes your storage even easier and save your space.
